∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y),
  Function.Injective ⇑f → IsClosedMap ⇑f → StableUnderSpecialization (Set.range ⇑f)

∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) {U V : X.Opens} (i : U ≤ V)
  (s : Set ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V))) {u : Set ↥X},
  u ⊆
      X.zeroLocus
        (⇑(CommRingCat.Hom.hom (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE i).op)) '' s) →
    (X.zeroLocus s ∪ (↑U)ᶜ).Finite → TopologicalSpace.IsSeparable u

∀ {V : Type} {s t : Set (Sym2 V)},
  s ⊆ t →
    ∀ {u : SimpleGraph V},
      sInf
          (⇑OrderDual.ofDual ⁻¹'
            insert u (Set.Icc (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet s) (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet t))) =
        OrderDual.toDual (u ⊔ SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet t)

∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) {U : X.Opens} (s : Set ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)))
  {u : Set ↥X},
  u ⊆ X.zeroLocus ↑(Ideal.span s) → ∀ {v : Set ↥X}, Codisjoint v u → X.zeroLocus s ⇨ v = v

∀ {α : Type} [inst_2 : Preorder α] {s : Set α},
  IsUpperSet s →
    ∀ {u : Set α},
      u ⊂ ↑(upperClosure s) ∩ ↑(lowerClosure s) →
        Nonempty ↑((↑(upperClosure s) ∩ ↑(lowerClosure s)) \ u)

∀ {V : Type} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V} {p : G.Walk v w},
  v ≠ w → ∀ {u : SimpleGraph V}, Finite ↑(u.incidenceSet p.penultimate ∩ u.incidenceSet w)

∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) {U : X.Opens} (s : Set ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))),
  (nhdsSet (coborder (X.zeroLocus s))).NeBot → (coborder (X.zeroLocus s))ᶜ ≠ ⊤

∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) {U : X.Opens} (s t : Set ↑(X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)))
  {u : Set ↥X},
  u ⊂ X.zeroLocus (s * t) →
    (X.zeroLocus s ∪ X.zeroLocus t).Countable →
      ∃ f, X.zeroLocus s ∪ X.zeroLocus t = Set.range f

∀ {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) {a b : V},
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ {u : Set (Set (Sym2 V))},
      u ⊂ lowerBounds (Set.Icc (G.incidenceSet a ∩ G.incidenceSet b) {s(a, b)}) →
        IsLUB (Set.Ioc u (Set.Iic (G.incidenceSet a ∩ G.incidenceSet b)))
          (Set.Iic (G.incidenceSet a ∩ G.incidenceSet b))

∀ {V : Type} {G : SimpleGraph V} {u v w : V},
  G.Adj u v →
    ∀ (p : G.Walk v w) (a : ℕ),
      (∀ x ∈ (u :: p.support).dropLast.getLast?,
          ∀ y ∈ (List.drop a (u :: p.support)).head?, G.Adj x y) →
        ∀ (h_10 : (u :: p.support).dropLast ++ List.drop a (u :: p.support) ≠ []),
          (∀ (y₁ y₂ : List V),
              (∃ (hl : y₁ ≠ []),
                  List.IsChain G.Adj y₁ ∧
                    y₁.head hl =
                        ((u :: p.support).dropLast ++ List.drop a (u :: p.support)).head
                          h_10 ∧
                      y₁.getLast hl =
                        ((u :: p.support).dropLast ++ List.drop a (u :: p.support)).getLast
                          h_10) →
                (∃ (hl : y₂ ≠ []),
                    List.IsChain G.Adj y₂ ∧
                      y₂.head hl =
                          ((u :: p.support).dropLast ++ List.drop a (u :: p.support)).head
                            h_10 ∧
                        y₂.getLast hl =
                          ((u :: p.support).dropLast ++
                                List.drop a (u :: p.support)).getLast
                            h_10) →
                  y₁ = y₂) →
            Finite
              ↑{x |
                  ∃ (hl : x ≠ []),
                    List.IsChain G.Adj x ∧
                      x.head hl =
                          ((u :: p.support).dropLast ++ List.drop a (u :: p.support)).head
                            h_10 ∧
                        x.getLast hl =
                          ((u :: p.support).dropLast ++
                                List.drop a (u :: p.support)).getLast
                            h_10}

∀ {V : Type} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v : V},
  G.IsUniversal v →
    ∀ {u : Set V},
      {v}ᶜ ⊆ u →
        sInf (⇑OrderDual.ofDual ⁻¹' Set.Icc (G.neighborSet v) u) = OrderDual.toDual u

∀ {α : Type} [inst_2 : LE α] (S : Set (UpperSet α)) {u : Set α},
  ⋃ s ∈ S, ↑s ⊆ u →
    ∀ {v w : Set α}, v \ u ⊂ w → Set.Ioc ((v \ ↑(sInf S)) \ (u \ ↑(sInf S))) w ≠ ∅

∀ {α : Type} [inst_2 : Preorder α] {s : Set α},
  IsLowerSet s →
    ∀ ⦃u : α⦄,
      u ∈ s →
        ∀ ⦃v : α⦄,
          v ∈ s →
            ∀ {w : Set (Set α)},
              Set.Iic (Set.Icc u v) ⊆ w →
                Set.Ioo (Set.Ioi s) (lowerBounds (Set.Icc (Set.Icc u v) s)) ⊆
                  Set.Ioo (Set.Ioi (↑(upperClosure s) ∩ ↑(lowerClosure s))) w

∀ {α : Type} [inst_2 : LE α] (s : LowerSet α) {u : Set α},
  (↑s)ᶜ ⊆ u →
    ∀ {v : Set α}, (∃ y ∈ (Set.Ioo v ↑s.compl)ᶜ, y ≠ u) → (Set.Ioo v ↑s.compl)ᶜ.Nonempty

∀ {α β : Type} [inst_3 : Preorder α] [inst_4 : Preorder β] {x_5 x_6 : LowerSet α}
  {x_7 x_8 : LowerSet β},
  x_5 ≤ x_6 →
    x_7 ≤ x_8 →
      ∀ {u : Set (α × β)},
        Disjoint u ↑(x_5 ×ˢ x_7) →
          ↑(x_6 ×ˢ x_8) ⊆ u ∪ ↑(x_5 ×ˢ x_7) →
            ∀ {v : Set (α × β)},
              ↑(x_5 ×ˢ x_7) ⊂ v →
                v ⊆ ↑(x_6 ×ˢ x_8) \ u → IsCofinalFor (Set.Icc (↑(x_6 ×ˢ x_8) \ u) v) ∅

∀ {α : Type} [inst_2 : LE α] (s t : LowerSet α) {u : Set α},
  ↑s ∩ ↑t ⊂ u →
    ∀ {v w : Set α},
      v ⊂ w → ¬IsMax (Prod.fst '' v ×ˢ Set.Icc (Set.Icc v ↑(s ⊓ t)) (Set.Ico v u))

∀ {V : Type} {G : SimpleGraph V} (self : G.Dart),
  (∃ y ∈ G.support, y ≠ self.toProd.1) → IsLUB (Set.Ioc G.supportᶜ Set.univ) Set.univ

∀ (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) {U : X.Opens} {u : Set ↥X},
  u ⊂ X.zeroLocus Set.univ → ∀ (v : Filter (Set ↥X)), IsOpen {u}
